newsitem.title: USA: Air Methods says to buy Mercy Air Services.
newsitem.headline: Air Methods says to buy Mercy Air Services.

text.p: Air Methods Corp said on Monday that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire all common stock of Mercy Air Services, Inc.
The purchase price to be paid by Air Methods is $5.92 million in cash and notes, subject to working capital adjustments, Air Methods said.
Mercy operates as an independent provider of helicopter air medical transportation services throughout Southern California to the Mexican border, a news release issued by Air Methods said.
Mercy Air has been profitable since its inception and currently operates six Bell 222's and two Bell 412 aircraft, the release said.
On a combined basis, Air Methods and Mercy Air revenues exceeded $45.8 million for the year ended December 31, 1996, the release said.
The acquisition is scheduled to close on July 30, the release said.
